model: Ethereum and Solana adapters are fuzz-qualified against malformed verifier output and malformed outbound recipient encodings. Invalid inbound proof fields must fail before replay consumption, and invalid outbound recipients must fail before nonce advancement or message creation.
invariants: wrong Ethereum chain identity fails closed
wrong Solana genesis identity fails closed
zero or malformed mandatory proof fields cannot consume replay state
Ethereum outbound recipients must be exactly 20 bytes
Solana outbound recipients must be exactly 32 bytes
invalid recipient encodings cannot advance outbound nonce
fuzzed malformed inputs cannot alter route, asset, verifier or emergency configuration
valid proofs and canonical recipient lengths remain accepted
qualification_tests: fuzz Ethereum mandatory finalized-transfer fields and assert rejection before replay mutation
fuzz Solana mandatory finalized-transfer fields and assert rejection before replay mutation
fuzz Ethereum outbound recipient byte lengths and assert only 20-byte recipients are accepted
fuzz Solana outbound recipient byte lengths and assert only 32-byte recipients are accepted
verify invalid recipient attempts preserve outbound nonce
verify valid canonical recipient lengths advance outbound nonce exactly once
follow_on: V12.6.6 domain, nonce and router-bypass hardening
